A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain readable text, equations, figures and tables across 12 pages. Both end with references; neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original KIE-HVQA evaluations, general OCR evaluations, and training-strategy and reward ablations in Section 5 and Tables 1–3.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results and ablation outcomes reported in Section 5 and Tables 1–3.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same cold-start data generation, supervised fine-tuning, GRPO procedure and OCR reward components. Algorithm 1 is unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same KIE-HVQA coverage derived from OCRBench, WildReceipt and synthetic documents, the same training sources, and the same standard OCRBench evaluation domains.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding tables: Table 1 retains the GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, InternVL3 and Qwen2.5-VL variants; Table 2 retains GPT-4o, Claude3.7-Sonnet, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and MiniCPM-o-2.6.

E3.justification: Dataset counts, degradation procedures and evaluation metrics are unchanged. Section 5.1 retains the same base model and SFT settings, including five epochs, a learning rate of 1e-6 and rollout batch size 512.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 retains the same SFT-versus-SFT-plus-RL comparison, general OCR capability preservation analysis, and clear-only, final-only and combined-reward ablations. The qualitative examples also remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Statistical uncertainty reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–3 and the qualitative findings match. For example, Table 1 reports the same overall averages of 58.05 for SFT+RL and 30.21 for GPT-4o in both versions.

T1.justification: The normalized group advantage, GRPO objective and reward expression in Equations 1–3 retain the same mathematical content and definitions. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the same benchmark and GRPO-framework contributions, the approximately 28-percentage-point improvement claim over GPT-4o, and the claim of preserving general OCR capability.

C2.justification: The explanations involving reliance on linguistic priors, uncertainty-aware grounding and composite rewards are unchanged. No substantive applicability qualifications, failure conditions or limitations are added.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the data-access pointer from the GitHub repository 2bgm/KIE-HVQA to the Hugging Face dataset bytedance-research/KIE-HVQA. This revises access information; implementation details and training-time disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 retains the same research positioning and novelty statements. All 42 cited works remain the same; reference differences concern spacing.

P1.justification: v2 adds a corresponding-author marker for Minghui Qiu alongside Ziheng Wu. Apart from the data-link update and version header, the prose, terminology and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page author block and abstract undergo minor spacing and line-wrap changes, with small typesetting adjustments elsewhere. All four figures, three tables and Algorithm 1 retain their content and placement.

improvement.justification: The methods, results, supporting analyses and explanations are unchanged. The revised dataset pointer, additional corresponding-author designation and minor typesetting adjustments leave the supplied paper's substantive quality and readability essentially unchanged. The PDFs do not establish that actual data availability improved.
